title: External Basket
description: external-basket/v2: the document a basket-registered event carries: a quantity-1 FinP2P basket asset that stands for a trade's collateral, and the account behind it, created for the trade the event cites. It has three uses: a collateral platform's account, registered by the router that opened it; the basket token issued over a ledger container, where chainId is finp2p and account is the container's finId; and a calculation agent's external basket, filled off FinP2P.

basketKey.description: Stable key the apps use for the basket; the event id is the key the guards use.

chainId.description: CAIP-2 chain id of the platform's collateral account.

basketAssetId.description: FinP2P asset id of the basket asset (quantity 1).

source.description: Where the collateral comes from: the pledger's account (its finId on a basket a router registered).

destination.description: Where the collateral goes on default: the receiver's account (its finId on a basket a router registered).

controller.description: Org id of the organization that controls the account: the one that opened a platform account, the receiver for a container's token, or as the calculation agent states it for an external basket.
